meta.title: Who really said "I like work: it fascinates me. I can sit and look at it for hours"? | Quotle.info
meta.description: Not Oscar Wilde. This comic line is Jerome K. Jerome, from Three Men in a Boat (1889), Chapter 15.
meta.ogTitle: Who really said 'I like work: it fascinates me. I can sit and look at it for hours'?
meta.ogDescription: Not Oscar Wilde — it's Jerome K. Jerome, Three Men in a Boat (1889), Ch. 15.

answer.label: Not Oscar Wilde — actually Jerome K. Jerome
answer.sourceLine: From Jerome K. Jerome's Three Men in a Boat (1889), Chapter 15; wrongly credited to Oscar Wilde.

source.heading: The source

docMeta.dd: Three Men in a Boat (To Say Nothing of the Dog)

source.excerpt: It is not that I object to the work, mind you; I like work: it fascinates me. I can sit and look at it for hours. I love to keep it by me: the idea of getting rid of it nearly breaks my heart.
